Nora (Finance): Alert from partner Ops — reseller 'NorthBridge' says their March payout is $0 but our GCP export shows billed usage. Can someone check attribution?
Vik (Billing Ops): On it. Which invoices?
Nora (Finance): They sent statement referencing customer invoice C-7782 and partner statement ID PS-2028-03-78.
gcp-billing-bot: Daily export gcp_billing_2028_03_31.csv processed at 2028-04-01T06:05:01Z.
Vik (Billing Ops): Quick query: `SELECT invoice_id, reseller_id, SUM(amount) FROM gcp_metering WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2028-03-01' AND '2028-03-31' AND invoice_id='C-7782' GROUP BY invoice_id, reseller_id;` -> reseller_id = NULL, amount = 8,400.
Sam (Partner Success): NorthBridge says they always get that customer via reseller tag NB-REGION-1. They sent a screenshot of their portal showing no payout for that invoice.
Vik (Billing Ops): Root cause looks like tag propagation failed for that customer's project during the 2028-03-01 metering deployment. The tagging service returned 500 for project cloud-nb-01 for a 6-hour window. I can see error spikes in the job logs.
Leo (Revenue Ops): Exposure for NorthBridge?
Nora (Finance): One invoice $8.4k. Search shows 3 other invoices across 2 resellers totaling ~$12,600. Total exposure ~$21,000.
Vik (Billing Ops): GCP support case opened: case GCP-2028-555. But GCP won't rewrite historical exports. Plan: 1) create provisional partner statements and queue provisional payouts; 2) request partner ack; 3) if GCP provides a re-emit, we'll reconcile and reverse provisional payments.
Sam (Partner Success): I'll contact NorthBridge and ask for signed ack accepting provisional payout pending reconciliation. They want funds this week.
Nora (Finance): Approve provisional payout for amounts <= $10k as contra-revenue. For >$10k require FP&A sign-off (tag @Marta). NorthBridge $8.4k OK.
Vik (Billing Ops): Uploaded CSV: https://redwood.app/sheets/gcp-attr-issues -> sheet "missing-reseller-2028-03". Columns: reseller_id_suspected, invoice_id, amount, action.
Leo (Revenue Ops): Accounting note: record provisional payouts as contra-revenue GL 4600 with memo referencing GCP case GCP-2028-555.
Sam (Partner Success): NorthBridge ack sent and signed, attaching to sheet. They prefer payout via ACH, provided bank last 4: 4321.
Vik (Billing Ops): Action items: @Vik produce provisional partner statements & payout batch; @Sam collect acks; @Nora book payable and run AP; @Leo log contra-revenue entries; @Marta loop if any partner >$10k. Marking P1 until provisional payouts complete.
Nora (Finance): Thanks. Keep updates brief in this thread for audit purposes. :white_check_mark:
